answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 44019 Country: India Title: Nikah Question: I want to know that can a person marry with granddaughter of his mother's sister (Khala/Mausi)? Please reply me as soon as possible. Answer ID: 44019 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 356/356/M=1434) Nikah is valid with the granddaughter of khala. وَأُحِلَّ لَكُم مَّا وَرَاء ذَلِكُمْ [النساء : 24] Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
